analysis:
Reviewed both primary analyses against the replayed patches and metadata, rather than treating their conclusions as proof. Together, .githooks/pre-commit and pre-push deletions remove console lint/build checks; .github/dependabot.yml base 3–28 removes console dependency-update configuration; ci.yml base 37 and 637–658 removes console routing and install/lint/test/build; component-changes.yml base 8–9 and 22 removes the corresponding outputs. These changes are consistent with each other. SKILL.md head 10–16, AGENTS.md patches at base 42–79, and CONTRIBUTING.md patches remove console-retention/tooling references and place the telemetry mirror in the platform, without changing executable trust enforcement.
No supplied patch changes provider authorization, attestation qualification, encryption, prompt/cache handling, billing, inference or local hold/fan controls. No concrete regression against TB-002/TB-011, T-008, T-041, T-052/T-053/T-054 or the other indexed boundaries is established. Removing console checks alone does not demonstrate a vulnerability; documentation changes also do not prove retirement or migration.
The local questions remain unresolved: confirm whether this PR retires the local console and its hosting/build consumers, whether another workflow consumes the removed console output, and whether removed console fixture tests provided provider-contract coverage needing preservation. An active dependency or security-relevant coverage loss is not established here and is therefore not reported as a finding. Replay omits 15 of 30 reviewed source units and supplies no console retirement/deployment evidence; remaining integration review should resolve these relationships. Selected canonical details and the index are not a full audit of definitions or unchanged dependencies.
